notes: router/auto policy v1. Tiers, lanes, never, probation and excluded come from config.draft.json (Jang, 2026-10-23). Model refs are provider/id:thinking; every id was checked against `pi --list-models` on 2026-10-24.

tier_from_difficulty.why: difficulty is the contract's 0-4 score (trivial .. very hard): < 1.0 basic, < 2.5 general, else deep

lanes.why: Jang: go-to when instructions are very explicit, no guesswork, solid code wanted fast
Jang: situationally for orchestration when goals are not ambiguous

never.why: Jang: more sycophantic than other families; keep them away from critique, debugging, rejection and false-success turns. Unambiguous goals are required for orchestration only, by the clear-orchestration lane's own spec_clear >= 0.8; creative prose is not gated on spec_clear (Jang: muse is for 'creative prose, and for orchestration when goals are unambiguous'). `theta` is the backend's calibrated threshold (config.draft.json had 0.5).

probation.policy: v1: never chosen. Later: exploration only, with logged propensity; never when latency_sensitive >= 0.5
probation.why: Jang: brilliant sometimes, won't speak other times, huge latency. History (both hosts): p50 15.9 s per assistant message vs opus 6.3 s; highest abort rate, 3.1% vs opus 1.4%

excluded.why: Jang: has its own usage meter, separate from every other model in his subscriptions; the router never selects it, including exploration

jev.provenance: new_goal and user_rejection: quantile-matched to claude-opus-5-5:max pilot labels (bench/gold/pilot-v1.claude-opus-5-5-max.jsonl; 53 turns with history; Opus yes 10 and 14) using bench/results/v3/jev-latest-typesafe.jsonl (contract v3, jev-1.14.0). new_goal: 0.65 is a 5-way tie at the cut (>=0.65 fires 11, >0.65 fires 9); the cut that fires less wins, 0.655 -> 9 fires, AUC 0.89. user_rejection: 0.3 sits between 0.31 and 0.29 -> 14 fires, 9 agree with Opus, AUC 0.86. false_success: no gold exists, so both backends fire on the same base rate, 4% of the 1125 states-v1 history turns (bench/results/v2/jev-latest-typesafe.jsonl, contract v2, same wording as live): 0.715 fires on 45 (4.0%); 0.5 fired on 136 (12.1%), too often for a switch that drops the cache. Reproduce: python3 scripts/derive_thresholds.py

local.provenance: StartLux 4B Q8 on agent-jail (bench/results/v2/startlux-4b-q8-jail.jsonl, contract v2), quantile-matched to the same Opus pilot labels. new_goal: between 0.689 and 0.625 -> 10 fires, AUC 0.84. user_rejection: between 0.411 and 0.307 -> 14 fires, AUC 0.90. false_success: same 4% base rate on the 1125 states-v1 history turns: 0.47 fires on 45 (4.0%); 0.5 fired on 42 (3.7%). Re-derive if the local model changes. Reproduce: python3 scripts/derive_thresholds.py
